Artiqulate

摘要Abstract

为 Artiq 量身打造的品牌升级与增长策略。项目依托对四十余家艺术咨询机构的全域市场及竞品深度调研结果，搭建面向艺术家与客户双向赋能的双轨营销策略，精准匹配两端核心诉求，拓展业务增长边界。同时落地专属创新产品原型，以全终端适配、数据透明、实时响应的藏品浏览界面，将「fair pay」的理念主张具象落地，强化艺术家与客户之间的深度联结，构筑品牌独有的竞争优势。

A brand and growth strategy for Artiq. Market and competitor analysis across thirty-plus art consultancies, a two-track marketing strategy for the artist and client ends, and a product prototype that turns fair pay from a claim into verifiable data.

Artiq 是一家总部位于伦敦、业务遍及全球的国际艺术代理与咨询公司。它把自己描述为一家通过策展当代艺术收藏与艺术体验、把客户与文化世界连接起来的艺术代理机构。其使命是「为品牌创造切实回报，为艺术家带来稳定收入」，在把当代艺术带入商业空间的同时，保证艺术家获得公平报酬。公司强调艺术讲述故事、凝聚社群的能力，并从多元的全球人才库中寻源与委托创作，供客户租赁或购买。Artiq is an international art agency & consultancy based in London, which operates globally and describes itself as an art agency that connects clients with the cultural world by curating contemporary art collections and experiences. Their mission is to “generate tangible returns for brands and regular income for artists” and to bring contemporary art into commercial spaces while guaranteeing fair pay to artists. The firm emphasises art’s ability to tell stories and foster community, and it sources and commissions art for lease or purchase from a diverse global talent pool.

对Artiq的启示

What it means for Artiq

头部市场规模收窄，中低端市场版图扩大。助力客户挖掘中端机会、管控价格风险、规划藏品策略的咨询服务愈发重要。

The market is thinner at the top but broader at the lower/mid end. Consulting that helps clients navigate mid-market opportunities, price risk and collection strategy is increasingly valuable.

三个结构性变化Three structural shifts

入场门槛下降Entry barriers fall

线上已占经销商销售的 22%（2019 年仅 13%），自有渠道份额翻倍。
重资产不再是入场的代价。

Online accounts for 22% of dealer sales (only 13% in 2019), with the share of proprietary channels doubled.
Heavy assets are no longer the price of entry.

线上同时是新客入口和老客纽带Online is both on-ramp and retention channel

46% 的线上销售额来自新买家，2023 年为 35%。
另有 40% 来自曾到访画廊或艺博会的既有客户。

46% of online sales value went to new buyers, up from 35% in 2023.
A further 40% went to existing clients who had visited galleries or fairs.

决策权交给客户Decision power shifts to clients

72% 的高净值经销商买家未看实物即经官网或线上展厅购买。
43% 通过 Instagram 购买。

72% of HNW dealer buyers bought via website or OVR without viewing in person.
43% bought on Instagram.

市场分裂为自助层与咨询层
——顾问从守门人变成了一个可选项The market splits into a self-serve layer and an advisory layer.
— The advisor moved from gatekeeper to option.

02 — Background Information

线上已成为新客户入口，也是持续运营的渠道。
ESG 已成为行业准入门槛。
停滞不动不只是落后，而是会被市场彻底甩开。Online is now the entry point and standing channel.
ESG is now a threshold.
Not acting is not falling behind — it is being bypassed.

  • 客户留存是行业公认的痛点。Retention is a known industry pain point.
  • 全渠道布局已是必然要求。Omni-channel is non-negotiable.
  • 线上是新客户的来源，但不等同于客户会自然留存。Online is where new clients come from — but they don’t automatically stay.
  • 中端市场及 5 万美元以下价位板块正在增长。Mid-market and sub-$50k segments are growing.
  • 公开拍卖市场热度回落，私密、低曝光的顾问服务愈发重要。Private, discreet advice is more important as public auctions soften.
  • 财富代际更迭叠加价值观念转变，催生全新的客户心智。Wealth transfer + values shift = new client psychology.

03 — Self-positioning

SWOT 分析SWOT Analysis

S优势Strengths内部 · 有利Internal · helpful
  • 全流程交付能力。16 年覆盖 briefing、策展、委托、采购、物流与安装。Turnkey delivery capability. Sixteen years spanning briefing, curation, commissioning, procurement, logistics and installation.
  • 艺术家网络与公平报酬基础。项目遍及 25 国；2021 年起累计支付艺术家 £7M+。Artist network and fair-pay foundation. Projects across 25 countries; over £7M paid to artists since 2021.
  • 定制化匹配能力。不依赖固定库存，可围绕空间、品牌与项目需求进行 sourcing。Tailored matching capability. Not reliant on fixed inventory; sources around space, brand and project needs.
  • 独立运营。自筹发展，具备较高的项目与品牌决策自主性。Independent operation. Self-funded, with substantial autonomy over projects and brand decisions.
W劣势Weaknesses内部 · 不利Internal · harmful
  • 差异化证据不足。fair pay 等主张已有基础，但合作机制与影响数据的可比较性有限。Limited proof of differentiation. Fair pay has a foundation, but its mechanisms and impact data remain hard to compare.
  • 客户侧数字化能力较弱。缺少自主浏览、选择、保存或协作的结构化工具。Limited client-side digital capability. No structured tool for browsing, selecting, saving or collaborating independently.
  • 品牌叙事分散。公平报酬、文化连接、可持续与多元并存，但主线不够稳定。Fragmented brand narrative. Fair pay, cultural connection, sustainability and diversity coexist without a stable central thread.
  • 规模与低价不占优。不具备大规模可检索库存，也不以标准化低价服务竞争。No advantage in scale or low price. No large searchable catalogue and no competition through standardised low pricing.
O机会Opportunities外部 · 有利External · helpful
  • 线上成为获客与留存渠道。经销商线上销售中，46% 的成交额来自新买家。Online is a channel for acquisition and retention. New buyers account for 46% of dealer online sales value.
  • ESG 需求进入采购环节。企业客户更重视可报告的社会影响与供应链透明度。ESG is entering procurement. Corporate clients increasingly value reportable social impact and supply-chain transparency.
  • 中端市场更活跃。高端市场趋于谨慎的同时，中低价位段交易保持增长。The mid-market is more active. Lower and mid-priced transactions remain active as the high end turns cautious.
  • 客户需要教育与参与。新作预览、艺术家幕后与空间转化内容具有明确需求。Clients want education and participation. New-work previews, artist behind-the-scenes and space-transformation content show clear demand.
T威胁Threats外部 · 不利External · harmful
  • 平台型竞争者压缩决策时间。在线目录、自助选品与推荐机制降低客户对顾问流程的依赖。Platform competitors compress decision time. Online catalogues, self-serve selection and recommendations reduce reliance on consultant-led processes.
  • 标准化低价服务分流客户。固定租期、透明价格与简化服务覆盖预算敏感型需求。Standardised low-price services divert clients. Fixed terms, transparent pricing and simplified services serve budget-sensitive demand.
  • 高端定制竞品叙事相似。多家机构同样强调策展、在地性、可持续与艺术家支持。High-end bespoke competitors tell similar stories. Many likewise emphasise curation, locality, sustainability and artist support.
  • 跨界替代方案增加。数字艺术屏、订阅内容、AI 与虚拟展示正在扩大空间艺术的替代选择。Adjacent substitutes are growing. Digital art screens, subscription content, AI and virtual display expand alternatives for spaces.

识别Identify

当用户上传或截图一张图片时，识别知名作品与风格流派。

Identify well-known artworks and styles when a user uploads or screenshots an image.

匹配Match

分析任意图像的美学特征，并将其与 Artiq 生态中的相关作品匹配。

Analyse the aesthetic features of any given image, then match it with relevant works in Artiq’s ecosystem.

收藏Archive

每件作品均有详细的原始数据，并直接标注艺术家分成、在地性和碳节省状况。

Every work carries detailed Metadata and states its artist share, local status and carbon saving.

画像Profile

随着客户持续浏览、收藏、比较与保存，系统为每个组织或用户累积个性化品味画像，并提供相似风格定制推荐。

As clients browse, favourite, compare and save, the system builds a personalised taste profile for each organisation or user and offers tailored recommendations.

05 — 可交互原型Working prototype

IDENTIFY → DISCOVER → CURATE：上传图片或选择预设图片，可进行扫描分析；从右侧报告点击作品匹配，收藏后可查看个人风格偏好画像与 ESG 汇总信息。完整 Demo 支持本地保存与报告导出。IDENTIFY → DISCOVER → CURATE: Upload an image or choose a preset to run the scan and analysis; click through from the report on the right to matching works, then save them to view a personal style profile and an ESG summary. The full demo supports local saving and report export.
